title: Woolly | Local memory for your AI tools
excerpt: Woolly gives Claude, Cursor and your own tools one shared memory that lives in plain files on your laptop. Open source, private, and free.
content_html:
Memory for your AI, kept on your laptop.

Woolly gives Claude, Cursor and your own tools one shared memory. It lives in plain files on your machine and never leaves your computer.
